name: IconButton
summary: A square Button containing only an icon. Required aria-label gives the control a name for screen readers and keyboard users.

ariaLabel.description: REQUIRED. The accessible name. Without it the button is invisible to assistive tech.

intent.description: Default 'ghost' for toolbar density. Use 'primary' sparingly — round + solid lime is loud.

size.description: Square dimensions: xs 24×24 / sm 32×32 / md 40×40 (default) / lg 48×48 / xl 56×56. Only md+ meets the 44 px touch floor on mobile.

shape.description: rect = rounded square (radius.control.md). round = full radius (FAB-shaped, status pings, chip-close).

pressed.description: aria-pressed=true. For toggle / segmented icon buttons (compose / decompose, view-list / view-grid).

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next control
Shift+Tab - move focus to previous control
rules: aria-label is REQUIRED. The component throws a TypeScript error if missing.
Provide a tooltip via Tooltip primitive after 600 ms hover-delay so sighted users know the icon's purpose.
If the same icon means different things in different contexts, the aria-label must disambiguate ('Edit row' not 'Edit').
Touch targets below 44×44 (xs / sm) are desktop-density only — do not use on mobile primary surfaces.

do: Use a recognized lucide-react icon. The icon set is opinionated; adding a new icon is a system decision.
Pair with Tooltip for disambiguation on hover.
Match the IconButton size to surrounding controls (toolbar buttons + IconButtons should share a height tier).
dont: Don't use IconButton without aria-label — TypeScript rejects it.
Don't use a custom icon that doesn't appear elsewhere in the system.
Don't use IconButton for the only primary action on a screen — pair with a labeled Button.

changelog.note: Formal IconButton primitive (was inline in primitives/button.tsx). Required aria-label, full size ladder, rect/round shape, all Button intents.
